::: {#exm-adjacency-list}
#### Two adjacency lists

The adjacency list (@def-adjacency-list) of the office graph (@exm-office-graph), on the left,
and of the web pages (@exm-web-links), on the right, are

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

| Vertex | Neighbors |
|:------:|:---------:|
| $a$ | $b, c$ |
| $b$ | $a, c, d$ |
| $c$ | $a, b, e$ |
| $d$ | $b, e, f$ |
| $e$ | $c, d, f$ |
| $f$ | $d, e$ |

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

| Page | Links to |
|:----:|:--------:|
| home | about, blog |
| about | contact |
| blog | home, blog, contact |
| contact | home |

:::

::::

In the office graph, each edge $\set{u, v}$ appears twice: $v$ is in the list of $u$, and $u$ is in the list of $v$.
In the web graph, each edge appears once, in the list of the page where it starts.

:::
